rule: Zero unexplained skips within THIS list. A listed test that is skipped, not discovered (absent from the collection), not executed (absent from the junit report, or errored before it could run) or whose oracle row is BLOCKED or NOT RUN makes the verdict INCOMPLETE (non-ACCEPT). A row that is NOT APPLICABLE counts only if it is listed under declared_not_applicable with a justification; any other NOT APPLICABLE is INCOMPLETE. A FAIL is a REJECT, never softened. Tests outside this list (other suites, historical suites, mvp-chain KL-01 which is non-mandatory) are neither required to be skip-free nor able to change the verdict.
verdict_precedence: INCOMPLETE over REJECT over ACCEPT. ACCEPT is a proposal for the owner only; it never authorizes anything and release stays HOLD.

oracle.note: v8 is listed with its sha256 together with the earlier files; the gate refuses a different hash for any of them. v7 stays byte-identical and listed. No expectation and no frozen file is changed to obtain a PASS: the gate refuses a different hash. v6 is the candidate mandatory expectation baseline (architect ruling Q1) and stays listed byte-identical; v7 is v6 plus the three required negative controls NC7-01..03 (architect ruling Q2), a builder-prepared proposal: Qualification owns the oracle and every verdict. Wording correction (added 2026-10-24, history not rewritten): the v7 status text and its unchanged_rows field say v7 is v6 byte-identical plus NC7-01..03. That is not accurate. The rows NC4-03 and NC4-04 differ from v6: NC4-03 changed (launch.py added to files_scanned; ingress_tree_sha256 ea37100d -> 0c0e2cf6) and NC4-04 was added. v7 itself is unedited (its hash is pinned above); this note, not an edit of v7, carries the correction.

supplementary_entries.note: Entries of kind supplementary_* are mandatory in the same sense as every other entry of tests (zero unexplained skips, a failure is a REJECT) but they are NOT oracle rows: supplementary_nc4_03_predicate lists every collected test of suites/mvp-chain/test_kwflow.py (self-tests of the NC4-03 data-flow predicate: negative and positive fixtures, pin records, tree digest, mutants); supplementary_nc2_06_negative_control lists the six tests of suites/mvp-chain/test_ingress_ambiguity.py (the supported-path test and five negative controls, each of which must FAIL the NC2-06 predicate). Listing them keeps G-13 (a collected test that is not committed is INCOMPLETE) satisfied and puts them under G-05/G-06. The NC2-06 oracle row itself is test_mvp_chain.py::test_row[NC2-06]. supplementary_route_b_mediation (MED-01..16, invocation d2-route-b) maps the existing route-B effect-path mediation tests of suites/mvp-d2-route-b/test_inventory_negatives.py (every test_REFUSED_* case, the Control Plane workflow-execute no-write check and the no-apply check; architect ruling Q5). The six remaining tests of that file are recorded as non-mandatory characterisations (D2C-01..06). Inventory counts are not governance claims: the unique claims are the oracle rows. v2 adds: supplementary_nc2_07_process_kill (KILL-01..18, suites/mvp-chain/test_process_kill_a1.py: the real SIGKILL harness checks, per-seam predicates and five negative controls); supplementary_nc3_04_ledger_pruning (PRUNE-01..08, test_ledger_pruning_a2.py); supplementary_nc4_03_mutation_set (NM-001..135, test_nc4_03_mutation_set.py: one test per frozen mutation or control plus structure and oracle-fragment checks) and supplementary_nc4_03_host_subcases (NM-136..143, test_nc4_03_host_subcases.py). The 183 KW entries still self-test the NC4-03 predicate and are not replaced.

inventory_vs_claims.statement: The inventory is not coverage. The battery lists 435 mandatory entries; only the 47 oracle_row entries are governance claims (one per mandatory oracle row of v8). The other 388 entries are supplementary tests: they substantiate, self-test or add negative controls to a claim, and do not add claims. Passing them does not widen what any row proves.
